description_en: Lists the host accounts for which the current Resource Access Management (RAM) user has authorization
description_zh: 获取当前RAM用户已授权的主机账户列表
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-operation-host-accounts --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListOperationHostAccounts

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the Bastionhost instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.
For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the host for which you want to query host accounts.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758857.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询主机账户的主机ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758857.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page when paging in a paged query. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return on each page when paging in a paged query.  
The maximum value of the PageSize parameter is 100. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned by default.
Specify a value for the PageSize parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the host account that you want to query. Only exact match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的主机账户名称。仅支持精确查询
parameters.name: host_account_name

true: A password is set.
false: No password is set

当前主机账户是否设置了密码。

true：已设置密码。
false：未设置密码
